  <text x="24" y="111" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="30" font-weight="700" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#050505">Create account</text>
  <text x="24" y="137" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#4E4B66">Stay informed. Start your news journey.</text>

  <text x="24" y="165" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#050505">Username</text>

  <text x="195" y="560" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#1877F2">Log in</text>

  <rect x="24" y="590" width="342" height="112" rx="6" fill="#000000" opacity="0.06"/>
  <rect x="24" y="588" width="342" height="112" rx="6" fill="#FAFAFA"/>

  <text x="88" y="666" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#4E4B66">stories that matter to you.</text>

    <text x="337" y="828" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" letter-spacing="0.12px" fill="#667080">Profile</text>
  </g>
